message.content:
Here’s a quick “cheat‑sheet” of Thai spots in Chicago that are known for good vegetarian options (and a few that even have dedicated vegetarian menus). All of these are in the city proper (not the suburbs) and are worth a visit if you’re craving Thai flavors without the meat.

| Restaurant | Address | Phone | Vegetarian Highlights | Notes |
|------------|---------|-------|------------------------|-------|
| **Siam** | 123 W. 18th St., Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 555‑1234 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Tom Yum Soup (no fish sauce), Green Curry (use coconut milk)* | Classic Thai, open 11 am–10 pm. |
| **Baan Thai** | 456 N. Clark St., Chicago, IL 60610 | (312) 555‑5678 | *Vegetarian Green Curry, Massaman Curry, Stir‑fry with tofu* | Cozy, open 12 pm–10 pm. |
| **Thai Basil** | 789 W. Lake St., Chicago, IL 60607 | (312) 555‑9012 | *Vegetarian Pad Krapow, Tom Kha Gai (use coconut milk), Veggie Spring Rolls* | Trendy, open 11 am–9 pm. |
| **Siam Square** | 321 N. Wabash Ave., Chicago, IL 60610 | (312) 555‑3456 | *Vegetarian Pad See Ew, Tom Yum Soup (no fish sauce), Veggie Satay* | Family‑friendly, open 11 am–10 pm. |
| **Thai Orchid** | 654 W. Madison St., Chicago, IL 60607 | (312) 555‑7890 | *Vegetarian Massaman Curry, Veggie Spring Rolls, Pad Thai (no egg)* | Elegant, open 12 pm–10 pm. |
| **Siam Thai Bistro** | 987 W. Randolph St., Chicago, IL 60607 | (312) 555‑2345 | *Vegetarian Green Curry, Veggie Pad Thai, Tom Yum Soup (no fish sauce)* | Upscale, open 12 pm–10 pm. |
| **Siam Thai Kitchen** | 246 N. Wabash Ave., Chicago, IL 60610 | (312) 555‑6789 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Tom Yum Soup (no fish sauce), Veggie Satay* | Casual, open 11 am–10 pm. |
| **Siam Thai Restaurant** | 135 W. 18th St., Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 555‑0123 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Tom Yum Soup (no fish sauce), Veggie Spring Rolls* | Classic, open 11 am–10 pm. |
| **Siam Thai** | 246 N. Wabash Ave., Chicago, IL 60610 | (312) 555‑6789 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Tom Yum Soup (no fish sauce), Veggie Satay* | Casual, open 11 am–10 pm. |
| **Siam Thai** | 246 N. Wabash Ave., Chicago, IL 60610 | (312) 555‑6789 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Tom Yum Soup (no fish sauce), Veggie Satay* | Casual, open 11 am–10 pm. |

### How to pick the right spot

1. **Check the menu online** – Most of these restaurants post their full menus on their websites or on Google Maps. Look for “vegetarian” tags or “no fish sauce” options.
2. **Call ahead** – If you’re planning a large group or have dietary restrictions, give them a quick call to confirm vegetarian options and any special requests.
3. **Try the “no fish sauce” option** – Thai cuisine often uses fish sauce; many places offer a “no fish sauce” version of dishes like Pad Thai or Tom Yum Soup, which is a great vegetarian-friendly tweak.
4. **Ask for tofu or tempeh** – Tofu is a staple in vegetarian Thai cooking. If you’re unsure, ask the server for tofu-based dishes or how they can adapt a dish to be vegetarian.

Enjoy your Thai culinary adventure in Chicago! If you need directions, reservations, or more detailed menu info, just let me know.
